name: Letchworth-Love Mounds Archaeological State Park
summary: Letchworth-Love Mounds Archaeological State Park is a 190.11-acre (76.93 ha) Florida state park in Jefferson County, Florida, about six miles (9.7 km) west of Monticello. It preserves the Letchworth-Love Mounds, a Woodland period mound complex on a low sandy rise near the southwestern shore of Lake Miccosukee. The site is recorded in the Florida Master Site File, the state's inventory of historical and archaeological resources, under the Smithsonian trinomial 8JE337. Its principal earthwork, Mound 1, stands about 49 feet (15 m) tall and is the tallest prehistoric Native American earthwork in Florida. The site was added to the National Register of Historic Places in 2010.
